description: Bring a resource to the Taifoon Grid and earn GRID points from measured probes. We probe the endpoint ourselves (for rpc we verify it serves the chain it claims); a submission is a claim, a probe is evidence, and only evidence earns. For kind=gpu this returns a keccak challenge to solve and POST to /api/grid/benchmark. POSTs to the live /api/grid/join.

chain_id.description: Required for rpc: the chain this endpoint serves (verified via eth_chainId)

endpoint.description: https:// or wss:// hostname endpoint (never a raw IP, never embedded credentials)

kind.description: rpc earns today; gpu is benchmarked and ranked but earns 0 until real GPU work exists

owner.description: 0x wallet address that earns the GRID points

pool.description: Optional: a declared pool (0x, see GET /api/grid/pools) this NEW resource works for. Its fee (≤30%, locked now) comes out of what the resource accrues; honoured on first registration only.

ref.description: Optional: the 0x wallet that referred this resource. It earns a share of what the resource accrues (measured work only). Never the owner itself.

name: taifoon_grid_join
